frequency_question: How often do such proposed rules reach final publication within the specified window?
membership_rule: Includes major federal agency rulemakings proposing significant fee hikes or cost burdens published for public comment; excludes minor technical amendments and rules initiated after month 30 of an administration.
window: 346 days from proposal to final rule publication

cases.name: DHS USCIS Premium Processing Fee Rule (2020)

coverage_note: 6 named representative major immigration/labor fee or cost rulemakings; believed to represent the typical success rate for high-salience administrative fee rules within the window.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-agency fee adjustments and rules outside immigration/labor domains, though general administrative law constraints apply uniformly.
validity_reason: Valid through the duration of the current presidential term, as rulemaking velocity and judicial review patterns remain stable under the current administrative apparatus.
